metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for autonomous building, session lifecycle, and agent waiting. Every guard ships with a negative test.

plugins.name: autobuild
plugins.description: Build a feature end to end without intermediate approvals: scope into units, build each in an isolated worktree, verify with standing lenses, and terminate on an independent judge's verdict against the original ask. Bundles `design`, which hardens a discussion into a build-ready handoff.

plugins.name: session-lifecycle
plugins.description: Close a session properly: distill what was learned into durable rules, sweep the Docker assets the session created, and file the thread as finished.

plugins.name: agent-waits
plugins.description: Make an agent wait without burning tokens — a bounded sleep across a rate-limit window, or a recurring self-healing wake loop that survives one.
